positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Used Node.js Child processes to establish a bidirectional flow of timing and functional data between a server and Electron.
* Improvised timing and tracing of functions by utilizing Node.js Performance API to process durations of each functions invoked on the call stack and to provide CPU interval metrics.
* Leveraged modularity and strictly pushed Observer design pattern with React to create a single page application by reusing UI components to remove redundancy and improve scalability amongst the application.
* Integrated a cross-platform application using Electron which includes dedicated channels such as ipcMain and ipcProcess which acts as message broker for broadcasint data through Electron.
